sources.title: Identical policy/reference cancellation and length scope
sources.details: Let m=(logπ(chosen|x)-logπ(rejected|x))-(logref(chosen|x)-logref(rejected|x)); identical deterministic scores imply m=0, hence -logσ(.1m)=-log(.5)=log2=0.6931471805599453. Complete answer scores sum all non-IGNORE byte/EOS log probabilities rather than length-average them; unequal lengths can change each raw margin, but the identical reference margin cancels. This does not establish post-training generation improvement.
